pages.title: Lay a route
pages.text: Connect straight Flux Beams and Flux Bend Beams into a continuous route, with space for the vehicle and rider. These beams can be walked through.$(br2)Use a Flux Levitator item directly on a beam to place the cart, then right-click it without sneaking to board.

pages.title: Drive the cart
pages.text: Aim at an end-panel hologram and click or drag its speed slider. The outer arrows change the setting by one. Negative settings reverse travel.$(br2)The red stop control brakes the cart. Sneak to dismount.$(br2)Check beam orientation at corners and slow down before testing a new route. Carts need no generator connection.
